name: YYDS pair-balance price manipulation
summary: consumptionReturnPool.getPriceOfUSDT() converted USDT-denominated return entitlements to YYDS at the YYDS/USDT pair's instantaneous token balances. Inside a flash swap that took almost all pair USDT, two attacker contracts withdrew their small matured returns at the crushed price, received far more YYDS than owed, and repaid the swap with that YYDS.
notes: The reset is setManagementAddress on the pool: getPriceOfUSDT reads the USDT, YYDS and pair addresses from that management contract, whose values were set in its constructor just before.

Loss is the pair's net USDT depletion. The 2,787.048 YYDS the pool released were sold into the same pair to cause it and are not valued again (rule 15). A 2022-09-20 drain via the management contract's setPair is an owner action and not part of this incident.
